known_original_code_security_bypasses: Two security findings identified and remediated during the v0.2.0 red-team phase (all 14 attacks now PASS): (1) cross-origin CSRF: runtime/web.py now rejects state-changing POST requests whose Origin/Referer does not match the runtime origin; (2) silent fail-open evidence drop: /api/evidence and /evidence previously dropped the connection when a ledger integrity chain broke; they now return a structured 500 (JSON) / HTML page naming the failed check. Additionally one functional defect (not a security bypass) was corrected pre-closure: resource.py write_bound present-target open flags O_WRONLY->O_RDWR, required for the pre-hash/read verification. No open bypasses in the final candidate.
